title: weld — ironically

phrases.translation: 焊透深度；焊接渗透；焊透
电弧焊；弧焊焊缝；电弧焊接
用垫环的焊缝；底焊焊缝；打底焊道
坡口焊，凹槽焊；开槽焊接
包铜钢丝；铜包钢丝；包钢铜丝

sentences.sentence: The new handle will have to be welded on.
sentences.translation: 新的把手得焊上去。

phrases.translation: 外表吸引力；体态吸引力

sentences.sentence: Do people believe anyone has one and only one measure of attractiveness?
sentences.translation: 难道人们真的认为吸引力只有一个衡量的尺度吗？

sentences.sentence: He rates her lower not only on attractiveness, but also on warmth and intelligence.
sentences.translation: 不仅是其吸引力，对她的热情程度和智力的评价都会降低。

sentences.sentence: And so the attractiveness ratings, as well as the frequency of messaging, are factored in.
sentences.translation: 所以吸引力指数，和传送信息的频率一样，被作为因素植入其中。

sentences.sentence: an achievement unparalleled in sporting history
sentences.translation: 体育史上空前的成就

sentences.sentence: However, contamination can occur at any point along the food chain, from field to table.
sentences.translation: 然而，污染沿着食物链可能在任何的点上发生，从田地到餐桌。

sentences.sentence: Others have said that all of Mars should be protected as a wildlife preserve where we do everything possible to avoid contamination; on the assumption Martian microbes could exist.
sentences.translation: 假设火星上可能存在微生物，其他人就认为火星应该是我们做任何事来避免污染的野生动物保护区那样来被保护着。

sentences.sentence: Usage: Mainly used in chemical, glass, dyestuff, ceramic and mechanic.
sentences.translation: 用途：主要用于化学、 玻璃、染料、冶金、机械、搪瓷等工业。

sentences.sentence: There are German dyestuff patents that were confiscated by the United States during the First World War and became part of the foundation of the American chemical industry.
sentences.translation: 还包括第一次世界大战时美国从德国没收的染料专利资料，并最终成为美国化学工业基础的一部分。

sentences.sentence: All the artwork can be eaten since no dyestuff is used, said Ju.
sentences.translation: 桔多淇表示，因为她没有用颜料，她的作品都能吃。

sentences.sentence: The sale of part of the company could be disadvantageous to investors.
sentences.translation: 对公司局部的出售可能对投资人不利。

translations.translation: 南方人, 居住在南方的人

sentences.sentence: Bob Wilson is a southerner, from Texas.
sentences.translation: 鲍勃•威尔逊是个南方人，来自得克萨斯州。

sentences.sentence: people forced to live grey, drab existences in ugly towns
sentences.translation: 被迫在丑陋的城市里过着平淡乏味生活的人

sentences.sentence: The stolen car was found in the vicinity of the station.
sentences.translation: 被盗汽车在车站附近被发现。

sentences.sentence: There used to be a mill in the vicinity.
sentences.translation: 附近曾有一座磨坊。

sentences.sentence: What stories can you relay that show your passion, initiative and resourcefulness?
sentences.translation: 你可以讲述什么样的故事来展示你的激情，主动和足智多谋呢？

sentences.sentence: Additionally, with no belief in your capabilities and resourcefulness, you find it hard to take up new challenges or to explore new frontiers.
sentences.translation: 除此之外，由于你不相信你很有能力而且足智多谋，你就发现迎接新的挑战或者探索新的领域是多么困难。

sentences.sentence: However, Dr Haselhuhn argues that physical clues to dishonesty could survive if they were also linked to qualities seen as positive by women – such as charm or resourcefulness.
sentences.translation: 然而，哈瑟尔罕争论道：如果这些生理特征对于女性来说是优点的话，比如说有魅力或者足智多谋，那么还是可能继续存在的。

sentences.sentence: The outrigger tripod is available in both a high and low profile version, to fulfill a diverse array of environmental requirements.
sentences.translation: 外伸的三脚架有高型和低型两种配置，以满足不同的环境要求。

sentences.sentence: I need some good pictures for narration.
sentences.translation: 我需要一些叙述时用的好镜头。

sentences.sentence: Her narration, she said, was meant to be ironic and self-mocking — “I find it very funny, almost obtuse.
sentences.translation: 她的叙述，她说，本来是想讽刺和嘲笑自己的——“我觉得这很有趣，我觉得自己是如此愚钝”。

sentences.sentence: It includes narration by some of the finest actors and academics of the last half century including Sam Waterston, Arthur Miller, and Shelby Foote.
sentences.translation: 该片中还有上半个世纪中优秀演员和专业学者像萨姆·沃森，亚瑟·米勒以及谢尔比·福特等的叙述。

sentences.sentence: Yet this we ask ere you leave us, that you speak to us and give us of your truth.
sentences.translation: 然而在你离开我们之前，对我们说话，把你的真理传述给我们。

sentences.sentence: Yet, if death be in this cup, I bid thee think again, ere thou beholdest me quaff it.
sentences.translation: 不过，要是这杯药可以致我于死地，在你眼看着我一口吞下去之前，我请求你再想一想。

translations.translation: [亦作useable] 可用的, 合用的

phrases.translation: 使用面积；楼面可用面积；可用地板面积

sentences.sentence: The computer language involved was readily usable.
sentences.translation: 所涉及的计算机语言便于使用。

sentences.sentence: usable information
sentences.translation: 可用的资料

sentences.sentence: The decor is a harmonious blend of traditional and modern.
sentences.translation: 这种装饰风格是传统与现代的和谐统一。

sentences.sentence: I was ready to leave everything behind and start anew in California.
sentences.translation: 我准备好舍弃一切，在加利福尼亚开始新的生活。

translations.translation: 具有讽刺意味地；嘲讽地

sentences.sentence: Ironically, his cold got better on the last day of his holiday.
sentences.translation: 具有讽刺意味的是，他的感冒竟在假期的最后一天有所好转。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 342 单元

weld
音标：英 /weld/  美 /wɛld/
v& n. 焊接，焊缝
短语：weld seam — 焊缝
短语：weld metal — 焊缝金属
短语：weld pool — 焊池
短语：weld joint — 焊缝
短语：butt weld — 对接焊缝；对头焊接
短语：spot weld — 焊点；点焊（缝）
短语：weld penetration — 焊透深度；焊接渗透；焊透
短语：weld line — 熔接线；焊接纹
短语：fillet weld — 角焊缝
短语：weld bead — 焊缝；焊珠；熔敷焊道
短语：arc weld — 电弧焊；弧焊焊缝；电弧焊接
短语：appearance of weld — 焊缝成形
短语：weld zone — 焊接区
短语：backing weld — 用垫环的焊缝；底焊焊缝；打底焊道
短语：girth weld — 环形焊缝；周围电焊
短语：weld strength — 焊接强度
短语：spiral weld — 螺旋形焊缝
短语：groove weld — 坡口焊，凹槽焊；开槽焊接
短语：corner weld — 角接焊缝；角焊；角焊道
短语：weld wire — 包铜钢丝；铜包钢丝；包钢铜丝
例句：The new handle will have to be welded on.
新的把手得焊上去。

fanners
音标：英 /'fænə/  美 /'fænɚ/
n. 电风扇,通风机

attractiveness
音标：英 /ə'træktivnis/  美 /ə'træktɪvnɪs/
n. 魅力,  吸引力
短语：physical attractiveness — 外表吸引力；体态吸引力
例句：Do people believe anyone has one and only one measure of attractiveness?
难道人们真的认为吸引力只有一个衡量的尺度吗？
例句：He rates her lower not only on attractiveness, but also on warmth and intelligence.
不仅是其吸引力，对她的热情程度和智力的评价都会降低。
例句：And so the attractiveness ratings, as well as the frequency of messaging, are factored in.
所以吸引力指数，和传送信息的频率一样，被作为因素植入其中。

unparalleled
音标：英 /ʌn'pærəleld/  美 /ʌn'pærəlɛld/
adj. 无比的, 空前的
例句：an achievement unparalleled in sporting history
体育史上空前的成就

saddle
音标：英 /'sæd(ə)l/  美 /'sædl/
n. 鞍；(自行车)座 vt装鞍
短语：in the saddle — 掌权；在职
短语：saddle point — 鞍点
短语：saddle up — 备马；给马装上鞍
短语：for the saddle — (马等)供骑乘用的
短语：saddle horse — 驯马，骑用马
短语：saddle stitching — [装订]骑马钉；[缝纫]鞍形针角

contamination
音标：英 /kən,tæmɪ'neɪʃən/  美 /kən,tæmi'neiʃən/
n. 污染, 污染物
短语：free from contamination — 无污染
短语：environmental contamination — 环境污染
短语：water contamination — 水污染
短语：contamination control — 污染控制；污染管制
短语：soil contamination — 土壤污染
短语：bacterial contamination — 细菌污染
短语：oil contamination — 油污
短语：radioactive contamination — 放射性污染
短语：microbial contamination — 微生物污染
短语：food contamination — 食品污染
短语：cross contamination — 交叉污染；交互粘染
短语：lead contamination — 铅污染
短语：source of contamination — 污染源
短语：surface contamination — 表面污染
短语：mercury contamination — 汞污染
短语：particulate contamination — 微粒子污染
例句：However, contamination can occur at any point along the food chain, from field to table.
然而，污染沿着食物链可能在任何的点上发生，从田地到餐桌。
例句：Others have said that all of Mars should be protected as a wildlife preserve where we do everything possible to avoid contamination; on the assumption Martian microbes could exist.
假设火星上可能存在微生物，其他人就认为火星应该是我们做任何事来避免污染的野生动物保护区那样来被保护着。

dyestuff
音标：英 /'daɪstʌf/  美 /'daɪ,stʌf/
n. 染料
例句：Usage: Mainly used in chemical, glass, dyestuff, ceramic and mechanic.
用途：主要用于化学、 玻璃、染料、冶金、机械、搪瓷等工业。
例句：There are German dyestuff patents that were confiscated by the United States during the First World War and became part of the foundation of the American chemical industry.
还包括第一次世界大战时美国从德国没收的染料专利资料，并最终成为美国化学工业基础的一部分。
例句：All the artwork can be eaten since no dyestuff is used, said Ju.
桔多淇表示，因为她没有用颜料，她的作品都能吃。

disadvantageous
音标：英 /,dɪsædv(ə)n'teɪdʒəs/  美 /,dɪsædvæn'tedʒəs/
adj. 不利的
例句：The sale of part of the company could be disadvantageous to investors.
对公司局部的出售可能对投资人不利。

southerner
音标：英 /'sʌð(ə)nə/  美 /'sʌðɚnɚ/
n. 南方人, 居住在南方的人
例句：Bob Wilson is a southerner, from Texas.
鲍勃•威尔逊是个南方人，来自得克萨斯州。

drab
音标：英 /dræb/  美 /dræb/
adj. 土褐色的, 单调的
短语：dribs and drabs — 点点滴滴；片断
例句：people forced to live grey, drab existences in ugly towns
被迫在丑陋的城市里过着平淡乏味生活的人

vicinity
音标：英 /vɪ'sɪnɪtɪ/  美 /və'sɪnəti/
n. 邻近, 附近
短语：in the vicinity of — 在…附近；在…上下
短语：in the vicinity — 在附近
短语：immediate vicinity — 紧邻
例句：The stolen car was found in the vicinity of the station.
被盗汽车在车站附近被发现。
例句：There used to be a mill in the vicinity.
附近曾有一座磨坊。

resourcefulness
n. 足智多谋
例句：What stories can you relay that show your passion, initiative and resourcefulness?
你可以讲述什么样的故事来展示你的激情，主动和足智多谋呢？
例句：Additionally, with no belief in your capabilities and resourcefulness, you find it hard to take up new challenges or to explore new frontiers.
除此之外，由于你不相信你很有能力而且足智多谋，你就发现迎接新的挑战或者探索新的领域是多么困难。
例句：However, Dr Haselhuhn argues that physical clues to dishonesty could survive if they were also linked to qualities seen as positive by women – such as charm or resourcefulness.
然而，哈瑟尔罕争论道：如果这些生理特征对于女性来说是优点的话，比如说有魅力或者足智多谋，那么还是可能继续存在的。

micronesian
音标：英 /,maikrəu'ni:ziən; -ʒən/  美 /,maikrəu'ni:ziən; -ʒən/
n&a. 密克罗尼西亚人(的)

outrigger
音标：英 /'aʊtrɪgə/  美 /'aʊt'rɪgɚ/
n. (承力外伸)支架
例句：The outrigger tripod is available in both a high and low profile version, to fulfill a diverse array of environmental requirements.
外伸的三脚架有高型和低型两种配置，以满足不同的环境要求。

narration
音标：英 /nə'reɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /nə'reʃən/
n. 叙述
例句：I need some good pictures for narration.
我需要一些叙述时用的好镜头。
例句：Her narration, she said, was meant to be ironic and self-mocking — “I find it very funny, almost obtuse.
她的叙述，她说，本来是想讽刺和嘲笑自己的——“我觉得这很有趣，我觉得自己是如此愚钝”。
例句：It includes narration by some of the finest actors and academics of the last half century including Sam Waterston, Arthur Miller, and Shelby Foote.
该片中还有上半个世纪中优秀演员和专业学者像萨姆·沃森，亚瑟·米勒以及谢尔比·福特等的叙述。

ere
音标：英 /eə/  美 /ɛr/
pron&conj. 在…之前
例句：Yet this we ask ere you leave us, that you speak to us and give us of your truth.
然而在你离开我们之前，对我们说话，把你的真理传述给我们。
例句：Yet, if death be in this cup, I bid thee think again, ere thou beholdest me quaff it.
不过，要是这杯药可以致我于死地，在你眼看着我一口吞下去之前，我请求你再想一想。

usable
音标：英 /'juːzəb(ə)l/  美 /'jʊzəbl/
adj. [亦作useable] 可用的, 合用的
短语：usable floor area — 使用面积；楼面可用面积；可用地板面积
例句：The computer language involved was readily usable.
所涉及的计算机语言便于使用。
例句：usable information
可用的资料

harmonious
音标：英 /hɑː'məʊnɪəs/  美 /hɑr'monɪəs/
adj. 和谐的, 和睦的
短语：harmonious socialist society — 社会主义和谐社会
短语：harmonious world — 和谐世界
例句：The decor is a harmonious blend of traditional and modern.
这种装饰风格是传统与现代的和谐统一。

anew
音标：英 /ə'njuː/  美 /ə'nʊ/
adv. 重新, 再
例句：I was ready to leave everything behind and start anew in California.
我准备好舍弃一切，在加利福尼亚开始新的生活。

ironically
音标：英 /aɪ'rɒnɪklɪ/  美 /aɪ'rɑnɪkli/
adv. 具有讽刺意味地；嘲讽地
例句：Ironically, his cold got better on the last day of his holiday.
具有讽刺意味的是，他的感冒竟在假期的最后一天有所好转。
